notes.title: Timeworks 1.2 is Live!
notes.content:
Timeworks 1.2 is Live!
We have listened to player feedback and have new features to show off!

1 - Alert System
A new system has been added to better articulate where you are in the levels! Just press E to let future clones know where to go with a little whistle. 

2 -  Steam Achievements
We finally added Steam achievements! If you have made progress, the achievements will automatically be given to you.

3 - New Levels
Get an S-rank in each zone to get a new achievement and unlock a new level per zone! These levels are some of the hardest levels we have made and they serve as a great reward for skillful execution.

We want to thank our fans for these great ideas and we hope there are many more to come! If you or a friend are interested in Timeworks, it is currently 50% off for the Steam Summer Sale!

notes.title: Timeworks Update v1.1
notes.content:
Hello Timework Enjoyers!

We have listened to our community and fixes some small issues with the game:


Storage has been given dialogue and geometry changes to be more intuitive to solve
Returning to the Level Select no longer brings you to the wrong level
Removed the zoom feature from the Level Select
Hitting Esc in the main menu or setting menu now does not close the game
Ranks are now shown in the level to provide a better experience for those hunting "S" ranks
FOV now starts higher and saves properly when changed
A special graphic has been added to the credits to thank our fans!


All of our updates save your progress you already have while making the game a better experience. We hope you enjoy these features and stay tuned for a bigger update coming soon!
